_vol_note: vol 0.09 is the repo's FTMO dial (v5_ftmo_challenge / v5_ftmo_wide), NOT v5_gold_max_sharpe's 0.20 — that config carries an explicit _dd_warning that it breaches a 10% wall BY CONSTRUCTION. 0.09 keeps the demo inside FTMO's rules so the book can actually be observed rather than halted.
_model_note: FTMO 2-Step (ftmo.com/en/trading-objectives, verified 2026-07-18): P1 +10% / P2 +5% target; 5% max daily loss (equity incl. floating, resets 00:00 CE(S)T); 10% max overall loss STATIC on initial; min 4 trading days; NO time limit; no 2-Step consistency rule; 1:100 leverage. This 4-asset book @9% sim: SR 1.67, ~97.1% pass, median ~10.5mo, path DD -11.8% (guard halts at 8%; the -11.8% is the 9-yr path, rarely realised inside a short challenge). Never raise vol mid-challenge.

session._note: Evening gate. No INCREASE in exposure from 17:00 to 01:05 SERVER time (= EAT; FTMO-Demo runs UTC+3 and the clock is read from the broker's own tick, not a hard-coded offset, so US DST cannot silently move the cutoff). Reductions, closes and compliance-SL maintenance always run, so the gate is a one-way valve. 01:05 is XAUUSD's measured reopen (M1-gap study 2026-10-08: XAU and US100 23:49->01:05, UKOIL 23:49->03:05, BTC 23:54->00:05); the 4-hourly timer next fires 03:40 server, by which point every sleeve is tradeable, so the full book returns in one pass instead of running 3-of-4 overnight.
session._note_2026_10_19: Evening no-increase gate DISABLED on this book. It was measured on the 4-sleeve book, not on this 2-sleeve one, and BTC trades 24/7 so an 8-hour nightly block is a materially different constraint for the crypto sleeve than for gold. Adding an unmeasured overlay to a freshly measured book is what RESEARCH-REGIMES 1.3.1/1.3.3 exist to prevent. Set disabled=false to restore it.

bottom_gate._note: Requested 2026-10-13: after a MANUAL close, a sleeve waits for the bottom detector before re-entering. MEASURED AS HARMFUL in V5_FINDINGS 3bm -- waiting costs 1.1-3.6bp of entry against a 2.59bp round trip, 18/18 cells negative, and the mechanism is adverse selection: at p>=0.60/8h, buying at market earned -22.80bp where the detector FIRED and +17.85bp where it did NOT (gap 40.65bp, t -5.23). Enabled by explicit request. Set enabled=false to revert to market entry, which won the study. max_wait_hours is the failsafe: the book only looks every 4h and the detector fires on ~8% of bars, so an ungated wait could leave a sleeve flat for days, which costs far more than the entry does.

_note:
3bq's A+B CELL, DEPLOYED ON DEMO. Measured head-to-head against the standalone XAU champion on a COMMON business-day index with the SAME continuous vol-targeted engine at the same 10% dial, so only the asset mix varies:
  A  XAU champion alone : Sharpe +0.919, CAGR +12.1%, maxDD -21.0%, FTMO pass 53.6%, fail-daily 17.6%
  B  BTC trend alone    : Sharpe +1.363, CAGR +14.9%, maxDD -13.8%, FTMO pass 65.3%, fail-daily  8.8%
  A+B 50/50 (THIS)      : Sharpe +1.511, CAGR +13.9%, maxDD -11.2%, FTMO pass 72.2%, fail-daily  0.0%
WHY A+B RATHER THAN B ALONE: the pre-registered gate required B to beat A at paired-t >= +2.0 and it reached only +1.07 on 6/11 years, so B does NOT replace A. A+B beats both on every axis and takes the DAILY breach rate from 17.6% to 0.0% -- which is the statistic that decides a prop account, since book-shootout established that Sharpe does not predict pass rate, the dial-scaled left tail against the daily limit does.
SCALE DISCIPLINE: XAU is H4 so champion_recipe takes scale 1.0; BTC is D1 so it takes 1/6 (rule 1.3.5, the D=6 trap). The first run of the comparison passed 1/6 to BOTH and collapsed gold's Sharpe to 0.476 -- caught because cell A's answer was already known.
HONEST STATUS: DSR 0.000 and PBO 0.381 on the 2-cell grid both FAIL CONTROL #6, and BTC's walk-forward speed picks wander the whole grid (3bp), so this is a 'real, unproven lead' in control #6's own words -- deployed on DEMO for exactly that reason. BTC speed is the book's existing 1/6, deliberately NOT the full-sample argmax of 1/12, which would import 3bp's measured +0.318 of selection bias.
